name: D3GA
aliases: D3GA — A method that creates animatable human avatars using drivable 3D Gaussians and tetrahedral cages for full-body modeling.
definition: A method that creates animatable human avatars using drivable 3D Gaussians and tetrahedral cages for full-body modeling.
summary: D3GA creates animatable human avatars from multi-view videos using drivable 3D Gaussians deformed by tetrahedral cages, distinguishing itself from similar methods through this specific structural approach.
